studies.title: The chicken
studies.caption: The colours and shape of the red junglefowl remain visible in domestic chickens. Birds drawn to farming landscapes eventually travelled with people across oceans.
studies.prompt: Full-body red junglefowl Gallus gallus rooster at edge of Southeast Asian rice clearing, gold-orange neck hackles, reddish back, dark iridescent green sickle tail, red comb and wattles, slender legs; small brown hen secondary in distance. Not giant modern meat chicken, no people or fence.
